meta.name: browserstack
meta.description: Run tests on BrowserStack. Use when user mentions "browserstack", "cross-browser", "cloud testing", "browser matrix", "test on safari", "test on firefox", or "browser compatibility".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在真实浏览器上运行跨浏览器测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多种浏览器和设备上验证网页表现
copy.tagline_en: Run cross-browser tests on real devices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify web app behavior across multiple browsers and devices

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 可以帮你把 Playwright 测试放到 BrowserStack 云端跑,支持配置、运行、查看结果、查可用浏览器、本地测试。会输出各浏览器的通过/失败状态和视频链接。
howto.when: 当用户提到“browserstack”“cross-browser”“cloud testing”等关键词,或要求做跨浏览器/云测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我把测试配置到 BrowserStack 上跑
say.note: 会添加 BrowserStack 连接配置

say.text: 用 BrowserStack 跑一遍跨浏览器测试
say.note: 会运行 Playwright 测试并汇报各浏览器结果

say.text: 查一下 BrowserStack 上有哪些浏览器可用
say.note: 会列出兼容的浏览器/系统组合

howto.what_en: Claude can run Playwright tests on BrowserStack cloud: configure, run, fetch results, list browsers, local testing setup. Returns per-browser pass/fail table with video/log links.
howto.when_en: Triggered by keywords like "browserstack", "cross-browser", "cloud testing", or when the user asks to test in multiple browsers (e.g., Safari, Firefox, browser matrix).

say_en.text: Configure my tests to run on BrowserStack
say_en.note: Adds BrowserStack connection options to Playwright config.

say_en.text: Run the cross-browser tests on BrowserStack
say_en.note: Runs Playwright tests and reports results per browser.
